title: release-cutover-checklist-2026-03-08-alex
content:
GOAL: Prod cutover for v2026.3.8 - deploy model-serving runtime changes + dedicated routing fixes.

Quick notes / timeline:
- 09:00AM: Final sync (eng-release, sres, oncall infra) - call #release-cutover (Slack) + Zoom link in CONFLUENCE-REL-CUTOVER-2026-03
- 09:15AM: Lock downstream deploys (announce in #eng-deploys)
- 09:30AM: Run canary on us-west1 (5% traffic) - monitor latency, error-rate, mem usage
- 10:00AM: Expand to 25% if canary stable for 20m
- 10:40AM: Full traffic if no regression by 30m at 25% stage

Pre-cutover checklist (do before 09:00):
- backport PRs: ensure backports merged and CI green (PRs: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/976, /pull/977)
- DB migrations: pre-run dry-run on staging (migration REL-MIG-12)
- Configs: confirm routing policy includes fallback models (config repo tag: v2026-3-config)
- Secrets: confirm KMS keys accessible for private deploys (ping security if blocked)
- Monitoring dashboards: open "Cutover overview" and tracer view. Have alert thresholds pinned.

Rollout commands (refs):
- deploy canary: ./scripts/deploy.sh --env prod --percent 5 --tag v2026.3.8
- promote: ./scripts/promote.sh --env prod --from canary --to full
- rollback: ./scripts/rollback.sh --tag v2026.3.7  # if >3% error or mean latency +50%

Health checks & KPIs to watch:
- 95th latency token gen (route: /v1/generate)
- error rate (5xx) by model variant
- queue depth and GPU util
- cost spike monitor (token/sec * gpu-hour)

Communication plan:
- Pre-cutover note: post in #release-cutover 30m before start with link to runbook (CONFLUENCE-REL-CUTOVER-2026-03)
- If canary fails: immediate note + tag eng-release, sres, and oncall; run rollback and file post-mortem ticket JIRA-RELPOST-xxxx
- Post-success: post rollout summary and a short blurb for product (cc: ProductOps)

Known risks / todos:
- legacy clients still hitting old routing rule (need temporary header rewrite) - patch in PR 982 (owner: Jordan)
- rare OOM on long-context sequences >32k tokens (observed staging x2) - SRE monitoring alert created (ALERT-1221)

Backports checklist:
- PR 976 -> branch release/2026.3 (merged)
- PR 977 -> branch release/2026.3 (needs review) -> action: @Samira to follow up 08:45

Post-cutover checklist (immediately after full traffic):
- run smoke tests: /tests/smoke/prod-smoke.sh (exit 0)
- confirm traces look normal for top 5 customers
- update deploy tracker spreadsheet (link in CONFLUENCE) and tag release in repo
- schedule 24h watch rotation for observability spikes

Notes to self:
- if anything blocks (CI, kms, infra), escalate to PM on call + open incident channel
- capture short video of failure mode if rollback happens (helps post-mortem)
- follow-up items: automated canary abort policy (create RFC), stash manual rollback steps into runbook

Open questions:
- do we need opt-in for dedicated customers to opt into new routing? (ask ProductOps)
- confirm SLA announcement wording before post-success comms

Scratchpad/todo (personal):
- 08:30: ping Samira for backport status
- 08:45: open Zoom + double-check runbook link
- 09:10: start canary rollout
- 10:30: if stable -> escalate to promotion

End of day: write short summary note (metrics + issues) to CONFLUENCE-REL-CUTOVER-2026-03
